observations: Single vehicle headlamp assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
Black internal housing with an integrated amber side reflector.
Watermark 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' present on the image.
No brand names, logos, or part numbers are legible on the lens or visible housing.

claims.claim: All Vehicle headlamps and rear lights are available

claims.evidence: The plastic wrap and single angle prevent distinguishing between a new part and a refurbished used part.

risks.risk: Broken or missing mounting tabs on the rear of the housing.
risks.proof: Photo of the back and sides of the unit showing all mounting points.

risks.risk: Incorrect fitment for the buyer's specific vehicle year or trim.
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's part number sticker or stamp.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic part of unknown compatibility

risks.risk: Internal electrical failure of LEDs or bulbs.
risks.proof: Video of the headlamp connected to a power source and illuminated.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the back of the headlamp showing the mounting tabs and any part number stickers.
The specific make, model, and year of the vehicle this part is intended for.
Photo of the headlamp without the plastic wrapping to check for lens scratches or cracks.
response.reason: The specific vehicle model this part fits is not identified. Because headlamp prices are highly dependent on the specific car model and year, a valuation is not possible without this information.
